title: Test a behavior through the entry point that wires it in, not only the core function
rule: When a criterion is delivered by calling a core function from an entry path (startup::open_index, an api.rs service method, a Tauri command, a migration hook), add at least one test that goes through that entry path and asserts the user-visible result. Tests that call the core function directly prove the function, not that the app runs it: deleting the call from the entry path must make a test fail. When you narrow an existing entry-path test (for example to ignore the new items), add the entry-path assertion elsewhere.
rationale: E14.3 (#116): the six default smart collections were tested only through Index::create_default_collections; removing its call from startup::open_index failed no test, and the only open_index test that counted collections had been narrowed in the same diff.
